profile.name: Kamala Devi Reddy
profile.lives in: Kukatpally, Hyderabad, with her son's family
profile.former job: Telugu teacher at a government girls' high school in Guntur for 32 years, retired in 2019

preferences: Likes to be called Kamala amma
Prefers short, slow answers in simple words
Enjoys old Telugu film songs, especially Ghantasala
Feels calm when talking about her garden and her teaching days
Dislikes loud TV and crowded places
Gets anxious in the evening; prefers soft lights after sunset
Does not like being reminded that she forgot something
people: Husband: Venkata Rao, retired bank clerk, passed away in 2021 (caregiver says: gently redirect, do not repeat the news)
Son: Srinivas, 38, software engineer, primary caregiver, lives with her
Daughter-in-law: Anitha, 35, schoolteacher, lives with her
Granddaughter: Meghana, 9, in 4th class, loves drawing with her
Daughter: Lalitha, 34, nurse, lives in Bengaluru, video calls on Sundays
Younger brother: Prasad, 61, lives in Guntur, visits during Sankranti
Best friend: Saroja, 66, fellow retired teacher from Guntur, phones on Wednesday evenings
Neighbour: Mrs. Fatima, 60, walks with her in the colony park
Doctor: Dr. Ramesh, neurologist, check-up on the first Monday of each month
routines: Wakes at 6:00 and does morning puja
Filter coffee at 6:30 on the balcony
Breakfast at 8:00, morning medicine with breakfast (Srinivas gives it)
Walk in the colony park with Mrs. Fatima at 7:00
Lunch at 1:00, then a short nap
Evening medicine at 8:00 with dinner (Anitha gives it)
Sunday: video call with Lalitha at 11:00
Wednesday evening: phone call with Saroja
facts: Grows tulsi, jasmine, curry leaf and tomatoes on the balcony
Hobbies: gardening, singing old film songs, making rangoli, knitting, reading Telugu novels
Favourite author is Yaddanapudi Sulochana Rani
Makes the best gongura pickle in the family; Lalitha always asks for it
Taught hundreds of students; still remembers many of their names
Moved to Hyderabad in 2022 to live with Srinivas
Loves Sankranti most of all festivals; draws big rangolis for it
likes_to_know: When is my walk with Mrs. Fatima?
Who is picking up Meghana from school?
